name: My Home Wife
source:
Sakumi is just married. She loves sex and now lives with her husband, Koutaro, father-in-law, and brother-in-law. One day, Koutaro goes abroad on business. When he leaves, he tells Sakumi, "Have sex with my father and brother while I'm away." She has no objection what he says and soon starts approaching. Well, what will happen to her family...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090216020907/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1012062]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
Sakumi刚刚结婚。她热爱性爱，如今与丈夫Koutaro、公公和小叔子共同生活。一天，Koutaro出国出差。临行前，他对Sakumi说：“我不在时，就和父亲还有弟弟做爱吧。”她对丈夫的话毫无异议，很快便开始主动接近两人。那么，她的家庭最终会变成什么样…？
